div.div: غِزْلُ نِسَآءٍ A follower and lover of women; as also نِسَآءٍ ↓ غِزِّيلُ : (JK:) [or both may be rendered one who talks, and acts in an amatory and enticing manner; or who plays, sports, dallies, or wantons, and holds amorous talk; with women:] ↓ غِزِّيلٌ is of the measure فِعِّيلٌ in the sense of the measure مُفَاعِلٌ; like حِدِّيثٌ and كِلِّيمٌ. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
